_metadata.title: Modeling Inhomogeneities during Parallel-Connected Fast Charging of Lithium-Ion Battery Systems
_metadata.scope: Fixed material and geometry constants only. No fitted, derived, or measurement-dependent values. No PyBaMM-base-set fallback values.
